meta.name: boardroom
meta.description: /cs:boardroom <brief> — 6-phase multi-role deliberation across the C-suite with Phase 2 isolation, critic pre-screen, and synthesis. Outputs a board memo. Use when a decision spans multiple executive domains — e.g. a pricing change touching finance, positioning, and product, or a raise-vs-cut runway call.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 模拟高管团队进行多角色决策讨论并生成纪要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要模拟C-level讨论来辅助复杂决策
copy.tagline_en: Simulate C-suite deliberation across roles and generate a board memo
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-role executive deliberation to support complex decisions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会模拟一个由多位高管顾问组成的董事会，对战略议题进行六阶段讨论，最终输出一份包含投票、异议和决策建议的董事会备忘录。
howto.when: 当你输入命令 `/cs:boardroom <brief>` 并提供一个战略简报文件路径时触发。适用于需要跨多个高管领域决策的场景，如定价调整涉及财务、定位和产品。

say.text: 用 /cs:boardroom 讨论是否要涨价20%
say.note: 触发董事会讨论定价策略

say.text: 运行 /cs:boardroom 分析裁员还是削减预算
say.note: 触发董事会讨论资金决策

howto.what_en: Claude simulates a board of C-suite advisors who deliberate a strategic brief through six phases, producing a memo with votes, dissents, and a decision recommendation.
howto.when_en: Triggered by the command `/cs:boardroom <brief>` with a path to a strategy brief file. Use when a decision spans multiple executive domains, e.g., pricing change affecting finance, positioning, and product.

say_en.text: Run /cs:boardroom to discuss a 20% price increase
Run /cs:boardroom to analyze layoffs vs. budget cuts
